title.rendered: A Town Lot w/ Stunning Views in the highly coveted Maya Vista Neighborhood!

content.rendered: A remarkable, spacious town lot situated on the elevated hillside of the highly coveted Maya Vista neighborhood in San Ignacio. Measuring a substantial 50×134 ft. (6,700 sq ft.), this parcel offers a premium footprint in a quiet, affluent residential enclave known for its large estates and opulent homes. The parcel is cleared and prepped for building, and sits directly on the paved Maya Vista Drive. It is also fully serviced with immediate access to municipal electricity and water. Because of its prime topographic elevation, the lot commands stunning 360-degree panoramic vistas of the surrounding countryside and the town below, providing a flawless blank canvas for a custom luxury build or a high-end private residence. Despite its tranquil, exclusive atmosphere, this Cahal Pech area property is strategically positioned right in the center of uptown, placing all daily conveniences, including supermarkets, banks, and hardware stores, just a stone’s throw away. For an investor or homebuilder looking to anchor their capital in a proven, high-end community, this parcel delivers a highly functional and secure foundation. Take advantage of a premier hillside homesite in one of Western Belize’s most desirable neighborhoods today!
